crossRefs.note: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have…
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.

translations.web: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.
translations.bsb: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
translations.kjv: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
translations.asv: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.
